'''Avar Hachami''' is [[Warder]] to [[Myrelle Berengari]]. Myrelle saved him after the [[Aes Sedai]] to whom he was Bonded died.

== Appearance ==
He was a dark-eyed [[Saldaean]]. He had a nose like an eagle's beak and a square chin with a thick graying mustache like down-curved horns. Rumor had it that Myrelle was married to her first three Warders: [[Croi Makin]], [[Nuhel Dromand]] and Avar Hachami. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Avar Hachami}}

== Activities ==
He arrives when [[Egwene al'Vere]] is dressing down Myrelle for hiding [[Lan Mandragoran]] in [[Salidar]] and detects Myrelle's somber mood.

He is guarding Myrelle's tent when [[Siuan Sanche]] arrives with the news that Egwene is still alive inside the [[White Tower]].
